reading.body:
QTS San Antonio II is a 32-acre campus in San Antonio with a published power capacity of 90 MW or more. Assuming 40 kW per rack, a common AI training density, 90 MW of IT load would support roughly 2,250 racks. The facility's specifications do not break down available square footage, individual building names, or what fraction of the 90 MW is currently subscribed.

The campus is one of 133 mapped data centers in Texas, but ranks outside the top 18 by published megawatts. Of the 468 MW in published capacity across Texas, this facility represents at most 19 percent, placing it below the state's established capacity leaders. No grid constraints specific to San Antonio are published.

QTS operates this campus as part of a regional portfolio that includes facilities in Irving and Tarrant County. The operator is a Blackstone-owned REIT founded in 2003 and taken public in 2013. The campus meets no published certifications for specialized workload classes.
